name: Lich
description: (Tag:dark+)(Tag:magic+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Lich, an Undead caste specializing in Necromancy and Dark Magic, not the phylactery kind. Though rather weak physically, you gain increased energy reserves and nigh-unlimited stamina, needing only your own Energy reserves to sustain yourself. You study magic more easily and gain increased Darkness and Necromancy affinity. In addition, you can naturally use [Lesser Necromancy] to raise your own Undead Servants.
